policy_title: 2026 Evolent Clinical Guidelines for Medical Necessity Review: Advanced Imaging Guidelines (v2)
source_file: rulebook_collection/domains/advanced_imaging/policy_pdfs/current_2026/2026 Evolent Clinical Guidelines - Advanced Imaging v2.pdf
source_quote: Failure of conservative treatment* for a minimum of six (6) weeks within the last six (6) months: NOTE - Failure of conservative treatment is defined as one of the following: ○ Lack of meaningful improvement after a full course of treatment; OR ○ Progression or worsening of symptoms during treatment; OR ○ Documentation of a medical reason the member is unable to participate in treatment

criteria.description: Evaluation of non-emergent neck pain without acute progressive cord compression
Completion of at least six (6) consecutive weeks of conservative therapy within the prior six (6) months
Conservative therapy completed within the preceding 6 months
Documented failure (lack of improvement, progression, or medically documented contraindication)

required_documentation: Physical therapy notes with attendance logs showing 6 weeks of active therapy
Physician clinical follow-up notes documenting persistence of symptoms post-therapy
review_notes: Standard conservative care prerequisite with 6-week trial within last 6 months.

policy_title: 2026 Evolent Clinical Guidelines for Medical Necessity Review: Advanced Imaging Guidelines (v2)
source_file: rulebook_collection/domains/advanced_imaging/policy_pdfs/current_2026/2026 Evolent Clinical Guidelines - Advanced Imaging v2.pdf
source_quote: Evaluation of Suspected Myelopathy (11,12) ● Progressive symptoms including hand clumsiness, worsening handwriting, difficulty with grasping and holding objects, diffuse numbness in the hands, pins and needles sensation, increasing difficulty with balance and ambulation ● Any of the neurological deficits as noted above NOTE: Does NOT require conservative care

criteria.description: Clinical suspicion of cervical myelopathy with progressive upper extremity dysfunction or balance difficulty
Objective neurological exam findings (hyperreflexia, clonus, gait instability, Babinski)

required_documentation: Neurological or orthopedic physical examination documenting myelopathic signs (hyperreflexia, Hoffman, Babinski, gait disturbance)
review_notes: Explicit policy exception stating cervical myelopathy does NOT require conservative treatment prior to advanced MRI.

source_section: INDICATIONS FOR CERVICAL SPINE CT / Evaluation of Trauma or Acute Injury (13)
source_quote: Evaluation of Trauma or Acute Injury (13)

criteria.description: Acute high-impact blunt cervical trauma or acute injury meeting Canadian C-Spine Rule or NEXUS criteria

required_documentation: Emergency department notes documenting high-risk injury mechanism, midline neck tenderness, or focal neurological deficit
review_notes: Acute cervical trauma pathway for rapid bony fracture evaluation.

source_quote: Suspected cervical cord compression with any neurological deficits as listed above

criteria.description: Suspected acute cervical spinal cord compression with objective neurological deficit

required_documentation: Neurology or spine surgery physical exam documenting motor weakness, sensory level, or hyperreflexia
review_notes: Urgent cervical cord compression indication bypassing conservative treatment.

source_section: INDICATIONS FOR CHEST CT / Follow-Up of Lung Nodules

criteria.description: Incidental solitary or multiple pulmonary nodules identified on recent chest radiograph

required_documentation: Chest X-ray report identifying newly discovered pulmonary nodule requiring CT characterization
review_notes: Diagnostic follow-up of radiographic pulmonary nodule per Fleischner criteria.

source_section: INDICATIONS FOR CHEST CT / Diffuse Lung Disease (DLD) / Interstitial Lung Disease (ILD)
source_quote: For suspected sarcoidosis after initial workup including Chest x-ray

criteria.description: Initial diagnostic workup with baseline chest radiograph completed

required_documentation: Chest X-ray report and clinical evaluation notes detailing respiratory symptoms or lymphadenopathy
review_notes: Diagnostic prerequisite chest X-ray before high-resolution CT for sarcoidosis.

source_section: INDICATIONS FOR CHEST MRI / Evaluation of Tumor
source_quote: Evaluation for suspected thymoma in Myasthenia Gravis patients (19)

criteria.description: Evaluation of the anterior mediastinum to assess for suspected thymoma or thymic hyperplasia

required_documentation: Neurology consultation note verifying myasthenia gravis diagnosis and positive acetylcholine receptor antibody or EMG findings
review_notes: Anterior mediastinal thymoma screening in myasthenia gravis.

source_section: INDICATIONS FOR CHEST COMPUTED TOMOGRAPHY ANGIOGRAPHY (CTA) / Known or Suspected Pulmonary Embolism (PE) (1–5)

criteria.description: Clinical suspicion of acute pulmonary embolism with high pre-test probability (Wells/Geneva score) or positive D-dimer

required_documentation: Clinical evaluation notes documenting Wells score, oxygen saturation, tachycardia, or quantitative D-dimer assay
review_notes: Emergency and outpatient pulmonary embolism protocol CTA.

source_section: INDICATIONS FOR CHEST MAGNETIC RESONANCE ANGIOGRAPHY (MRA) / Known or Suspected Pulmonary Embolism (PE) (1–5)
source_quote: Suspected pulmonary embolism when CTA is contraindicated or cannot be

criteria.description: Clinical suspicion of acute pulmonary embolism
Chest CTA is contraindicated due to severe iodinated contrast allergy or severe renal insufficiency

required_documentation: Medical documentation detailing severe contrast anaphylaxis history or eGFR precluding iodinated contrast
review_notes: Alternative modality selection when first-line CTA cannot be safely performed.
